Fit a replication tempo curve to every region

Source: R/fit_rep_tempo.R
fit_rep_tempo.Rd

Fits one curve per row of a rep_tempo() table (regional replication percentage against genome-wide replication progress) and extracts timing features from it.

Usage

fit_rep_tempo(
  df_rep_tempo,
  rep_percent = NULL,
  model_type = c("sslogis", "gam_low", "gam_fast"),
  n_boot = 0L,
  conf_level = 0.95,
  seed = 1L,
  gam_k = 10L,
  gam_method = c("GCV.Cp", "REML"),
  gam_fixed_df = FALSE,
  anchors = TRUE,
  grid_points = 1001L,
  curve_ids = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

Arguments

df_rep_tempo

Output of rep_tempo(): numeric regions by progress groups, values in 0-100, with unique row names.

rep_percent

Optional sorted progress values in 0-100, one per column, for a plain matrix without the rep_bins attribute.

model_type

"sslogis" (default), "gam_low" or "gam_fast".

n_boot

Number of bootstrap replicates; 0 (default) disables the bootstrap. 200 replicates take hours genome-wide.

conf_level

Confidence level of the percentile intervals.

seed

Non-negative integer seed for the bootstrap.

gam_k

Maximum basis dimension of the GAM smooth (reduced automatically for regions with few points).

gam_method

Smoothing-parameter method, "GCV.Cp" or "REML".

gam_fixed_df

If TRUE, fit an unpenalised regression spline with fixed degrees of freedom (fx = TRUE).

anchors

Add the two fixed end-point observations to the SSlogis fit.

grid_points

Number of grid points on 0-100 used for curves, AUC and grid-based thresholds.

curve_ids

Region IDs whose fitted curves are returned in the curves attribute; NULL means all regions.

verbose

Print progress messages. Default FALSE.

BPPARAM

A BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam; regions are fitted independently. Worker processes are limited to one BLAS/OpenMP thread.

Value

A data.frame with one row per region: region_id, model_type, fit_status, t10/t25/t50/t75/t90 with their status columns, window_10_90, max_slope, auc, auc_normalized, fit diagnostics (rmse, r_squared, deviance, residual summaries), SSlogis parameters, QC flags and bootstrap intervals. Attributes: fitted and residuals (percent, at the input progress values), curves, rep_bins, range_info, settings and units.

Details

"sslogis" is an unweighted three-parameter logistic NLS (Asym * plogis((x - xmid) / scal)) with two optional fixed end-point observations (0 at 0 percent, 1 at 100 percent) and a plinear fallback. "gam_low" and "gam_fast" fit the same Gaussian mgcv GAM y ~ s(x) and differ only in how thresholds are extracted: "gam_low" refines them with uniroot, "gam_fast" interpolates on a dense prediction grid. GAM fits are neither bounded nor monotonic; QC flags record this.

Thresholds (t10 ... t90) are real increasing crossings inside each region's observed progress range; thresholds that are not crossed, or are crossed more than once, are NA. They are in genome-wide percentage points, as is window_10_90 = t90 - t10.

The bootstrap resamples the observed (progress, percentage) points with replacement and refits the model. It is a group-level interval, not a cell-level one. A CI is reported only when at least max(20, ceiling(0.7 * n_boot)) replicates give a valid estimate. Row i uses seed seed + i - 1, so serial and parallel runs agree. The caller's RNG state is restored.

See also

rep_tempo(), subset_rep_tempo()
